Update an installed plugin to the newest stable release

## Synopsis

```text
Update an installed plugin to the newest stable release or a specific version.

The plugin must already be installed. Use 'plugin install' to install new plugins.
```

```text
finfocus plugin update <plugin> [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  # Update to the newest stable release
  finfocus plugin update opencost

  # Update to specific version
  finfocus plugin update opencost --version v0.1.2

  # Preview update without making changes
  finfocus plugin update opencost --dry-run
```

## Options

```text
  -h, --help[=true|false]            help for update
      --plugin-dir string            Custom plugin directory (default: configured)
      --skip-checksum[=true|false]   Skip SHA256 checksum verification during update (refused when FINFOCUS_SECURE_PLUGINS is on)
      --version string               Specific version to update to (default: newest stable release)
```
